about: A supply drop (planning/workstreams/supply.md): the hum of its shaft of light, its capsule passing overhead, its three jets lighting, burning and cutting, and its landing on three legs.
notes: First round, 2026-11-21. Six sounds; the rest of a drop's occasions fall to the tech, bang and weather families (shared/sound/cues.ts, supply/*). MOSS denoises thirty seconds whatever is asked, so each one-shot's prompt asks for several with pauses, and the events are taken apart. The takes were chosen by measure and not yet by ear (tools/sound/README.md: nothing merges until the owner has listened). Shaft: the steady hum (27901), not the pure 440 Hz tone that pulsed (27900) or the second round's two that wavered. Jet: the roar with body from 100 Hz up (27930); the second round's two were nothing but rumble under 150 Hz. The model leaves a narrow tone at 16 kHz in its jets, which the build's 32 kHz resample takes out. Ignite: the first prompt gave burns of five to ten seconds, so the second asked for short bursts and three of its were kept. Pass, cut and land: whole events only, none cut off by the end of its file; a cut begins at the pop as the roar stops.

shaft.want: a tall column of light humming

prompts.text: A tall column of pure light hums: a steady airy electrical tone with a soft glassy shimmer and a slow gentle pulse, calm and bright, unchanging. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A steady soft breathy drone of air moving in a long glass pipe, with a low electrical hum beneath it and a faint high shimmer, calm, constant and unchanging. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

Three separate fly-bys with pauses of silence between them: each time a small meteor passes fast overhead, a tearing whoosh that rises quickly, roars past and falls away into a low rumble. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

ignite.want: three small jets lighting at once

prompts.text: Three separate ignitions with pauses of silence between them: each time three small rocket engines light at once with a sharp crack and a whump, then a hard roaring hiss for a second that stops. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

Five separate short bursts with long pauses of silence between them: each time a gas burner lights with a sharp pop and a whump, a brief one-second burst of flame, then silence. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Small rocket engines burning steadily: a continuous roaring hiss with a deep flutter, steady thrust, unchanging. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

The deep rumbling roar of a rocket engine burning steadily, heard close: a low thunderous rumble with a crackling flame, constant and unchanging. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

Three separate shutdowns with pauses of silence between them: each time roaring rocket engines stop abruptly with a short falling hiss, a pop, and the ticking of hot metal. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

land.want: a heavy capsule landing on three legs

prompts.text: Three separate landings with pauses of silence between them: each time a heavy metal capsule drops onto three legs on hard ground with a deep thud, a metallic clank and a short hydraulic hiss. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
